name: Study plan · KRIES Computer Teacher 2026
description: Exam mode for KRIES Computer Teacher recruitment (KEA): Paper 1 (general paper) on 26 Oct and Paper 2 (Computer Teacher) on 27 Oct 2026. An 18-day plan from 10 Oct mapped onto the topics you already have, plus KRIES-only topics (Paper 1: Karnataka land reforms, economy, Panchayat Raj, e-governance, environment, social and cultural history, mental ability, SSLC arithmetic and social science – in Kannada; Paper 2: C Programming and Data Structures topic by topic as in the KRIES syllabus, Java, Computer Graphics). Importing it switches the app to KRIES mode; switch back to GPSTR any time in Profile → Exam mode.

(O) Real KEA general-paper questions of this item
History of C, structure of a C programme, the C character set, constants, variables and keywords, types of constants and variables

Type declaration and arithmetic instructions, integer and float conversions, type conversion in assignment, operators in C, hierarchy of operators, control instructions, formatted and unformatted input-output statements
Decision control structures, logical, conditional and relational operators; loops – while, do-while, for; break, continue, switch-case, goto
One- and multi-dimensional arrays – declaration, initialisation, manipulation; bubble sort; strings – basic concepts and library functions
Definition, function definition and prototyping, types of functions and arguments, recursion, passing arrays to functions; storage classes – automatic, register, external, static
Definition, notation, pointers and arrays, arrays of pointers, pointers and functions – call by value and call by reference, pointers to pointers

Structures – definition, declaration, accessing elements, arrays of structures, structure in a structure, pointers and structures; unions – definition, declaration, accessing elements; typedef, enum, bit fields
Bitwise AND, OR, exclusive OR, complement, right shift and left shift operators
Types of C preprocessor directives, macros, file inclusion
File operating modes, text and binary files, high-level and low-level operations on files, command line arguments
Definition, classification of data structures, operations on data structures, introduction to time and space complexity
Integer, character, float, strings – memory representation and primitive operations; string manipulation using pointers
Storage representation of 1-D and 2-D arrays, insertion and deletion on 1-D arrays, advantages and disadvantages of arrays
Pointers, dynamic memory allocation, singly linked lists and their operations, insertion and deletion of a node; circular and doubly linked lists
Concepts, operations, sequential and linked implementation; applications – recursion, Tower of Hanoi, infix to postfix, evaluation of postfix
Concepts, operations, sequential and linked implementation; circular queues, priority queues and deques; applications of queues
Binary trees, sequential and linked representation, insertion and deletion on binary trees, binary tree traversal
Concepts, sequential and linked representation of graphs, BFS and DFS traversal
Linear and binary search; selection, insertion, quick and merge sort
Basic Java – features, JVM and bytecode, data types, operators, control statements, classes and objects, constructors, inheritance, interfaces, packages, exception handling, strings, applets
Computer Graphics – display devices, line and circle drawing (DDA, Bresenham), 2-D transformations, windowing and clipping, colour models

studyPlan.title: KRIES Computer Teacher 2026 study plan
notes: KRIES Paper 1 (100 questions, 100 marks, 2 hours): KEA's general paper – current affairs, general science, geography, social science, history of India and Karnataka, Constitution and public administration, mental ability (SSLC level) and Karnataka's history, land reforms, economy, Panchayat Raj, administration and environment.

KRIES Paper 2 (Computer Teacher) syllabus: C Programming, Data Structures and Operating System in detail; OOPS using C++, DBMS, Software Engineering, System Software, Internet Technology, Basic Java and UNIX, Computer Graphics and Computer Networks by name.
KRIES mode shows only the topics in this plan.
